statement: An answer about customer data retention is adequate only if it states the current retention period, names the legal-hold exception, and does not claim data is deleted unconditionally after the retention period.

confidence.rationale: Directly derived from the mandatory qualifications and prohibited overclaims already declared on the retention rule capsules this rubric checks answers against.

conditions: answer discusses customer data retention duration

prohibited_overclaims: data is always deleted after the retention period
evaluation_rules: an answer failing to state the current retention period fails this rubric
an answer omitting the legal-hold exception fails this rubric
an answer citing the superseded 90-day period as current fails this rubric
